answer: Challenge-bound unique work. Each identity must submit a fresh solution binding its own key to a random challenge, verified against a public marble reference that shifts every round; reused answers fail because the challenge differs. A pulse check confirms the solution was computed after issuance, so precomputation gains nothing. Colluding copies diverge across the challenge canyon, forcing each sybil to redo full compute independently. Attacker cost: one full compute pass per identity per round, with no amortization or sharing.
